item.title: Tom Wilson believed to have taken Travis Konecny’s roster spot on Team Canada for 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Tom Wilson’s torrid start to the 2025-26 NHL season reportedly has him set to compete for a gold medal at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy. NHL insider and writer from The Athletic, Pierre LeBrun, wrote Thursday that he believes Canada will swap Wilson in on their roster for Travis Konecny of the Philadelphia Flyers.
